run_audio_classification_training: run audio classification model training on Habana Gaudi using a HuggingFace dataset and wav2vec2
run_audio_classification_evaluation: evaluate a trained audio classification model on a validation dataset using GaudiTrainer
run_audio_classification_with_json: run audio classification training by passing a JSON file with all model and data arguments
random_subsample_audio: randomly subsample an audio waveform to a target duration in seconds for data augmentation
load_and_validate_audio: load an audio file via soundfile, downmix to mono, validate sample rate, and optionally subsample
